meta.title: Osteosarcoma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: High-grade osteosarcoma (localized and metastatic), adolescent/young-adult and adult
meta.population: AYA and adult patients with high-grade osteosarcoma - THE FORTY-YEAR PLATEAU: chemotherapy transformed this disease once (Link's randomized receipt VERIFIED: 36 patients, 2-year relapse-free survival 17% without chemotherapy versus 66% with - and the number-swap trap documented: the famous 6-year figures belong to the 1991 update, not quoted here) and then stopped improving - the plateau itself VERIFIED (Mirabello/SEER: survival 'did not improve significantly from 1984 to 2004,' with a title-verified extension receipt to 2017). ~900 US cases/yr (the verified snippet - the briefing's ~1,000 corrected), bimodal (AYA peak + an elderly second peak with Paget/post-radiation biology carried at illustrative grade). THE RESPONSE-ADAPTED TRAP is the spec's architectural centerpiece: histologic response (Huvos >=90% necrosis) is the disease's strongest PROGNOSTIC read - and THREE ERAS of randomized evidence (COSS-82; EURAMOS-1 MAPIE; JCOG0905 - all PMID-verified) proved you CANNOT convert it into an intensification switch. The property suite enforces it: no arm conditions on the Huvos read.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the forty-year plateau. THE TRAP IS THE ARCHITECTURE: EURAMOS-1's two randomized lessons ship verified - MAPIE intensification for poor responders bought NO benefit and more toxicity (design verified; the HR held at memory grade), and maintenance interferon for good responders showed no significant benefit WITH substantial never-started/discontinuation (the 'feasibility failure' briefing framing corrected to the honest compound reading) - flanked by COSS-82 (1988) and JCOG0905 (2025): three eras asked whether the necrosis read could steer intensificati…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: High-grade osteosarcoma as the entity (conventional/subtypes at convention grade); the boundaries explicit - Ewing sarcoma is the registry's NEXT queued row (blocked), conventional CHONDROSARCOMA is the surgery-only chemo-resistant boundary (VERIFIED receipts: unresectable conventional 1-yr OS 48%, 5-yr 2%; IDH biology verified), soft-tissue sarcoma reroutes LIVE; staging as localized vs primary-metastatic with the lung as the overwhelmingly dominant relapse site (the ~80% figure softened to memory grade)
meta.response: Histologic response (Huvos; Rosen's verified 1982 concept paper; the Bielack 1,702-patient COSS receipt verified WITH its duplicate-PubMed-record trap documented) - taught as PROGNOSTIC-NOT-ACTIONABLE; imaging response conventional; relapse surveillance lung-focused

refs.label: THE ORIGIN RECEIPT: Link et al., adjuvant chemotherapy vs observation (NEJM 1986 - PMID 3520317, pubmed-url-match): 36 randomized - 2-year RFS 17% observation vs 66% chemotherapy, p<0.001 (verified snippet). THE NUMBER-SWAP TRAP documented: the famous 6-year figures (~61% vs 11%) belong to the 1991 MIOS update (NOT verified this sweep - NOT quoted); larger cohort totals belong to the declined-randomization group | PMID 3520317 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE PLATEAU, verified: Mirabello, SEER 1973-2004 (Cancer 2009 - PMID 19197972, pubmed-url-match): 3,482 patients - survival 'did not improve significantly from 1984 to 2004' (verified snippet); the 1975-2017 extension receipt title-verified (35226758). The ~60-70% localized band is convention-grade and says so | PMID 19197972 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE THREE-ERA TRAP, verified: EURAMOS-1 MAPIE vs MAP in poor responders (Marina, Lancet Oncol 2016 - PMID 27569442, pubmed-url-match: design verified - >=10% viable tumour, <=40, open-label; the no-benefit HR ~0.98 + excess toxicity MEMORY-GRADE, held) + the good-responder interferon paper (Bielack, JCO 2015 - 26033801, matched: design verified; the result framing CORRECTED - 'no significant EFS benefit with substantial never-started/discontinuation,' not bare 'feasibility failure') + COSS-82 (1988 - 2448428, matched: salvage-by-response failed) + JCOG0905 (2025 - 40138604, matched: MAP+IFO in poor responders). Three eras, one lesson: prognostic, not predictive - enforced by property | PMID 27569442 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE PROGNOSTIC READ: Rosen's concept paper (Cancer 1982 - PMID 6174200, pubmed-url-match: 57 patients; the >90%-necrosis grading concept; Huvos the convention-grade eponym) + Bielack's 1,702-patient COSS prognostic receipt (JCO 2002 - 11821461, matched) WITH THE DUPLICATE-RECORD TRAP documented: PMID 37713812 carries the IDENTICAL title - a title-matcher cites the wrong record; cite 11821461 | PMID 11821461 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE SURGICAL CONVENTIONS + the pathologic-fracture nuance on verified receipts: limb-salvage-equals-amputation and the tract convention (convention-grade; the classic equivalence papers honestly unsearched); pathologic fracture NOT an absolute contraindication (meta-analysis 2012 - PMID 23226744, matched: 7 studies/284 patients, LR OR 1.48 [0.67-3.30], 5-yr OS OR 1.85 [0.86-3.98] - verified snippet) held in tension with the newer worse-survival review (37184541, title-verified) - both carried | PMID 23226744 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

SURGERY-FIRST RELAPSE, verified: the classic thoracotomy receipt (1986 - PMID 3542182, matched); REPEAT resections (9564899, matched - the 60% five-year repeat-thoracotomy figure snippet-attributed); the modern series (33349447, matched - ~43.5% 5-yr OS; adverse: incomplete resection, >2cm, DFI<12mo - snippet-attributed, abstract-read pending); Kempf-Bielack 576-patient relapse receipt (JCO 2005 - 15659502, matched: complete surgery ESSENTIAL; time-to-relapse + burden prognostic) + second-recurrences (19075282, matched); the open-vs-VATS methods receipt (36085388, matched). The ~80%-pulmonary figure SOFTENED to 'overwhelmingly dominant site' (memory-grade) | PMID 15659502 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE EVIDENCE-APPRAISAL NODE, fully receipted: INT-0133 first report (Meyers, JCO 2005 - PMID 15774791, pubmed-url-match: 662 patients, 2x2 factorial; ifosfamide NO EFS benefit; the ifosfamide-MTP interaction question EXPLICIT) -> the update (JCO 2008 - 18235123, matched: OS significantly improved, 'one-third reduction in risk of death'; EFS trend only; exact p-values memory-grade) -> the published skepticism (18565905, title-verified: 'Complexities in interpretation...') -> ODAC 12-2 AGAINST (2007-05, SEC-filing-verified; not-approvable 2007-08; a 2012-dated headline documented as a dating hazard) vs EMA APPROVAL (2009-03-06: ages 2-30, resectable non-metastatic, with postop chemo). US REALITY: NOT FDA-approved - NEVER CARDED (property) - with the live expanded-access route named (NCT04571229, MSK-listed) | PMID 18235123 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE TKI CONVENTION - two-positive regorafenib (the strengthened point): SARC024 osteosarcoma cohort (Davis, JCO 2019 - PMID 31013172, pubmed-url-match: 42 patients, 1:1 vs placebo - THE BLANKET-PROTOCOL TRAP documented: SARC024's cohorts have separate PMIDs, never cite it bare) + REGOBONE (Duffaud, Lancet Oncol 2019 - 30477937, matched: French, 4 parallel cohorts, 2:1) + cabozantinib CABONE (Italiano, Lancet Oncol 2020 - 32078813, matched: single-arm). ALL magnitudes MEMORY-GRADE and deliberately UNQUOTED pending abstract re-reads | PMID 31013172 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

GENOMICS HONESTY: Chen et al. (Cell Rep 2014 - PMID 24703847, pubmed-url-match): TP53-pathway lesions in ALL discovery tumors (intron-1 translocations the signature); RB1/ATRX/DLG2 recurrent - structural chaos, NO recurrent targetable driver (the reason this menu has no genotype router). The chromothripsis citation honestly DEFERRED (Stephens 2011 unsearched; a subclonal-74% figure exists only in a PREPRINT - never anchored) | PMID 24703847 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE NEGATIVES, taught loudly: checkpoint MONOTHERAPY null in osteosarcoma (pembrolizumab ph2 + avelumab NCT03006848 + the SARC028 bone experience - read out, essentially null; secondhand); NAKED anti-GD2 DEAD (AOST1421 dinutuximab+GM-CSF NEGATIVE - DCR ~28-31% vs the bar; secondhand + PMC) - GD2 survives ONLY as CAR-T (the PERSIST door verified). Property-enforced: no checkpoint inhibitor carded (IO lives only in trial combinations - TACOS)

THE CHONDROSARCOMA BOUNDARY, verified: conventional chondrosarcoma is chemo-resistant surgery-only territory (unresectable conventional: 1-yr OS 48%, 5-yr 2% - PMID 24995550, matched, verified snippet; role-of-chemo receipt 24099780, matched; first-line outcomes incl. dedifferentiated/mesenchymal 30082492, matched); IDH biology verified (Amary, J Pathol 2011 - 21598255, matched: >=56% of central cartilaginous tumours; R132C ~40%). A boundary note - not this trainer's disease | PMID 24995550 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EPI, corrected: ~900 US cases/yr (~400 under 20; ~300 deaths/yr - verified-snippet aggregate via Ottaviani/Jaffe 20213383, title-verified + Mirabello) - the briefing's ~1,000 CORRECTED to the verified figure; bimodal verified (Mirabello; second peak >60); secondary osteosarcoma at ILLUSTRATIVE grade (the NZ single-institution series 18752128, matched: Paget's median 7.25mo; post-RT median 33mo, latency ~13.5yr - small, labeled); >40 series 12509946 (matched); the bimodal-questioning PREPRINT noted, never anchored

THE LOUD ALMOST - OST-HER2 at exactly its truth: phase 2b (NCT04974008) POSITIVE - 12-mo EFS 33% vs 20% historical (P=.0158); 1-yr OS 91% vs 81%; 2-yr OS 61% vs 40% (secondhand, multi-source); ROLLING BLA under Accelerated Approval (Type B pre-BLA; prior ~2026-09 company target SLIPPED (refresh 2026-08-20): BLA incomplete; stats-methods meeting mid-Sept; complete submission expected late 2026 - said exactly); Fast Track + Orphan + Rare Pediatric (PRV-eligible); confirmatory phase 3 opens Q3-2026 AUSTRALIA-FIRST. STATUS TODAY: NOT approved; NOT an open US door (the 2b closed to accrual). THE IDENTITY CONFLICT logged: one source equates the 2b with COG 'AOST2121' - UNVERIFIED

THE SHELF: the CAR-T layer - GD2 PERSIST (NCT04539366, recruiting, verified) + B7-H3 Seattle (NCT04483778, verified) + HEROS 3.0/Stanford/St.Jude (NCTs UNVERIFIED) + INCITE-ON (NCT07211737, not-yet-recruiting); the DDR/targeted relapse doors (olaparib+ceralasertib NCT04417062 UCSF-listed; azenosertib+gem and T-DXd osteo NCTs UNVERIFIED); CaIRS (NCT06156410, CHOP); aerosol gemcitabine (NCT03093909, MDA); atezo+SBRT+surgery (NCT06492954, status unverified); SARC038 CLOSED (results pending); the mifamurtide expanded access (NCT04571229); AOST2031 re-verified RECRUITING 2026-08-20 (flag cleared); EX-US never US doors (Qarziba trials; MEMOS); ~8 NCTs flagged unverified in total

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
